text:
lina: FYI I opened a docs PR that updates our console examples to use p50/p95 metric names and fixes the tracehook SDK snippets. Small but causes playground errors and a couple of 404s in the prebuilt dashboard preview. Can someone eyeball? :eyes:

marco: link? running into this in a customer demo yesterday so would love a quick turnaround.

lina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4988 
summary: replace legacy metric `latency_ms` -> `p50_latency_ms` (keep p95 as extra_series), rename tracehook param `trace_id_header` -> `trace_key_header`, add a compatibility note and a redirect for old guide path.

riley: saw failed qa on the docs CI, it flagged the example panel query that used `latency_ms` (not present in our telemetry export anymore).

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck failed at /console/observability/old-latency-guide (404). Linter: deprecated-field warning for `latency_ms` in examples/dashboard_examples.yaml

marco: can you paste the before/after YAML here? speeds review.

lina: pasted below. Old:```yaml
panels:
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
    label: latency_ms
New:```yaml
panels:
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p50_latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
    label: p50_latency_ms
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p95_latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
    label: p95_latency_ms
    display: extra_series
```

lina: tracehook snippets too. Old python snippet:```python
from rdw_obsv import TraceHook
th = TraceHook(header='x-rdw-trace', trace_id_header='x-rdw-trace')
```
New python snippet:```python
from rdw_obsv import TraceHook
th = TraceHook(header='x-rdw-trace', trace_key_header='x-rdw-trace-key')
# note: trace_id_header is still accepted but deprecated; prefer trace_key_header
```

tasha: I'll update the Go and TS snippets in the PR, and add a unit test that checks the shim accepts `trace_id_header` for backward compatibility.

riley: UX note: displaying both p50 and p95 is good for docs. Suggest leaving p95 collapsed by default to avoid noisy charts. If you add a one-liner explaining when to prefer each quantile that should cover most readers.

marco: agree. Also please add a small troubleshooting section: "If panels show blank, check that your exporter uses p50/p95 metrics and not legacy names."

infra-bot: infra-alert: queued task to add a metric-name deprecation detector. Will scan docs/examples for `*_ms` patterns and report findings in #eng-infra tomorrow.

lina: I added the one-liner and the troubleshooting blurb. I also added a docs changelog entry. Pushed updates to the PR.

docs-bot: PR updated by lina (tests: lint, linkcheck). Linkcheck now fails on one external reference to an old blog post, flagged as 410.

marco: that blog link is low-value in the example; please just remove or replace with the new perf note.

lina: removed and replaced with internal perf primer link. PTAL @tasha @riley

tasha: LGTM, left one nit about code fence language tags.

riley: reviewed, approves. :+1:

docs-bot: PR merged by lina (docs CI: success) — site deploy scheduled for 2026-04-05 02:15 UTC

lina: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the infra task and leave the redirect ticket for jonah to land on main after deploy. Closing thread. :)
